widgets_values:
# TEST: EPS Distributor - one image, three branches, each on/off

**Just press Run.** No checkpoint, no lora, no GPU, no setup - it only moves
one image around. Takes a second.

## Pass 1 - everything on (how it ships)

Press **Run** once with all three toggles ON. You should get:

- `output/eps_disttest/branch_A_00001_.png` - the plain image
- `output/eps_disttest/branch_B_inverted_00001_.png` - **colour-inverted**
- a preview of the image on the `PreviewImage` node at the bottom

That is three branches off ONE image in ONE run. Nothing ran twice.

## Pass 2 - turn a branch off (the actual test)

Click the little **checkbox next to `out_2`** on the EPS Distributor so it
goes dark, then press **Run** again. Now:

- `branch_A_00002_.png` appears - branch A still runs
- **NO new `branch_B_inverted_` file** - branch B was skipped
- the preview still updates - branch C still runs

The important part: the **Invert** node in the middle of branch B never
executed either. A disabled output skips the WHOLE chain hanging off it, not
just the node touching it. Watch the canvas during Run - Invert never
highlights.

## Pass 3 - all off is legal

Turn all three off (or use the **Toggle All** box in the node's header) and
press Run. The queue should finish **successfully** with nothing new written
and no error. That is intended: an all-off Distributor simply means nothing
downstream of it runs this time.

## Pass 4 - the outputs grow as you wire them

Notice the node has FOUR sockets but only three branches: `out_4` at the
bottom is empty and waiting. That's the rule - there is always one spare
socket below the last one you wired.

Wire `out_4` to anything (add a Preview Image) and watch `out_5` appear on
its own. Wire that and you get `out_6`. You never have to go hunting in a
menu to add a branch. Sixteen is the ceiling.

Unwiring does NOT take a socket away again: a socket you have already seen
stays, so a name you typed on it can't vanish underneath you.

## Also worth a click

- **Right-click the node -> Properties -> `Outputs`** to set the number by
  hand - handy for tidying up after you've grown past what you need. Only
  sockets at the BOTTOM are added or removed, so the wires you already have
  never jump to a different output.
- Try lowering `Outputs` to **1** while `out_2` is still wired: it should
  **refuse** to go below 2 and tell you `out_2` is wired. Unwire it first and
  it will go all the way down.
- **Double-click an output** - the socket or anywhere in its row - to give it
  a real name like `upscale branch`. It's display-only: wires and toggles
  don't care.

widgets_values:
## Toggle a row

Each `out_N` has its own checkbox to the LEFT of its label. Off = that branch is skipped this Run. The header box toggles all of them at once (it shows a dash when they're mixed).

Wire the bottom socket and a new one appears below it - the outputs grow as you use them, up to sixteen.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## Branch A

Plain save. This one is your control - it should keep producing files no matter what you do to the other two.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## Branch B is a CHAIN

Invert sits between the Distributor and the save. Turn `out_2` off and BOTH nodes skip - that's the whole point. A skipped branch costs nothing.
